description: This file defines an interface and a class related to version management in Orleans runtime. It includes methods for getting and setting compatibility and version selector strategies, as well as a state class for persisting these strategies.

classes.name: VersionStoreGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class that holds the strategies for compatibility and version selection, including overrides.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global compatibility strategy and persists the state.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global version selector strategy and persists the state.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy (with interfaceType)
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy (with interfaceType)
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for a specific interface type.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current global compatibility strategy.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current global version selector strategy.
